ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lucia
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Ah, this is a dream come true! I can't believe I get to meet THE Drossel!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Ах, это сбывшаяся мечта! Не могу поверить, что мне удалось встретиться с Дросселем!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lucia
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Ah, I have a copy of your book, "Created Eyes"...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Ах, у меня есть экземпляр вашей книги «Сотворенные глаза»…

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lucia
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: ... Could you please sign it for me?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: ... Не могли бы вы подписать это для меня?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Yes, of course. Like this?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Да, конечно. Так?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lucia
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: That's lovely! I'll treasure this forever! Thank you so much, Drossel!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Это прекрасно! Я буду хранить это вечно! Огромное спасибо, Дроссель!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Lucia seemed really excited! What was that all about?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Люсия выглядела очень взволнованной! Что это было?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Oh, you saw that?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: О, ты это видел?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Yes, we did. You signed something for her?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Да, мы это сделали. Ты что-то для нее подписал?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Have you published a book, Drossel? You did say that you write things, right?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Вы опубликовали книгу, Дроссель? Ты же говорил, что пишешь что-то, да?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Sorry, girls, can you give me some room? I'm still not used to all this attention...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Простите, девочки, не могли бы вы дать мне немного места? Я еще не привык к такому вниманию...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: But yes, I did have a book published a while back. It's called "Created Eyes".
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Но да, некоторое время назад у меня была опубликована книга. Это называется «Сотворенные глаза».

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: It was pretty well received, so sometimes I get fans coming up to me like that.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Это было довольно хорошо принято, поэтому иногда фанаты подходили ко мне вот так.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Wow, really? What kind of book is it?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Вау, правда? Что это за книга?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Ready for this? A romance about puppets in a puppet shop!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Готовы к этому? Романс о куклах в кукольном магазине!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Forbidden love between puppets from rival shops is the best part, I think.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Я думаю, что запретная любовь между марионетками из конкурирующих магазинов — лучшая часть.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Hahaha, you certainly have a theme, don't you! Right, Lydie?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, у тебя определенно есть тема, не так ли! Верно, Лиди?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: How lovely! Drossel! I want to read that book myself!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Как мило! Дроссель! Я сама хочу прочитать эту книгу!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Really? Of course, I'll give you a copy!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Действительно? Конечно, я дам вам копию!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Great! Thank you! I'll read it as soon as I get home!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Большой! Спасибо! Прочитаю, как только приду домой!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: It's no good... She's got the bug already. These bookworms, I don't know what to do with them!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Это бесполезно... У нее уже есть ошибка. Эти книжные черви, я не знаю, что с ними делать!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Although I'm wondering about it myself now... I'll just have Lydie tell me what is it about, later.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Хотя сейчас я сам об этом думаю... Я просто попрошу Лиди рассказать мне, о чем идет речь, позже.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Ah, this looks good! This too! Ah, I can't make up my mind!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Ах, это выглядит хорошо! Это тоже! Ах, я не могу решиться!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Ah, excuse us! Drossel?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Ах, извините! Дроссель?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Hey, girls! What's up? Here to eat?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Эй, девочки! Как дела? Здесь поесть?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: No, we were just passing by. What about you, Drossel? What are you doing here?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Нет, мы просто проходили мимо. А ты, Дроссель? Что ты здесь делаешь?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Shopping, of course! There are so many great things on sale here in Merveille!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Конечно же, шопинг! Здесь, в Мервейле, продается так много замечательных вещей!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Hahaha. Which means I've bought too much again!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Ха-ха-ха. Это значит, что я снова купил слишком много!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Oh. How much did you spend?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Ой. Сколько вы потратили?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: About 30,000 Coll...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Около 30 000 Колл...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: What! That much?! We could live for a year on that!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Что! Так много?! На это мы могли бы прожить год!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Sue... I think that's a bit of an exaggeration.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Сью... Я думаю, это немного преувеличение.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: But it's still a lot of money. And you can afford it, Drossel?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Но это все равно большие деньги. И ты можешь себе это позволить, Дроссель?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Won't this make Mr. Fritz mad?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Не разозлит ли это мистера Фрица?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: No, it's fine! Reading lots of different books is best for a writer.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Нет, все в порядке! Для писателя лучше всего читать много разных книг.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: He'll forgive me, if I tell him I'm doing it for our plays!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Он меня простит, если я скажу ему, что делаю это для наших спектаклей!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: R-Really? I can see him at least sighing a bit over this...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Р-Правда? Я вижу, что он хотя бы немного вздыхает по этому поводу...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: No, it will be fine. Hey, there's something I want to ask you.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Нет, все будет хорошо. Эй, я хочу кое-что у тебя спросить.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Do you know somewhere fun to do some shopping? Can you tell me?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Знаете ли вы место, где можно весело совершить покупки? Вы можете сказать мне?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: What, you're going to do more shopping? Uwah! I'm jealous. I want to be able to spend too!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Что, ты собираешься делать еще покупки? Ува! Я ревную. Я тоже хочу иметь возможность тратить!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: No, Sue, you can't. Right, well, on this street there's a place called the Corneria Enterprise...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Нет, Сью, ты не можешь. Хорошо, ну, на этой улице есть место под названием Корнерия Энтерпрайз...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: The Corneria Enterprise... Right, thanks!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Корнерия Энтерпрайз... Точно, спасибо!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: That's not the way! Ah, she really gets lost, doesn't she?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Это не так! Ах, она действительно заблудилась, не так ли?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: I don't think I've ever seen Drossel heading in the correct direction toward anything... Right?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Не думаю, что я когда-либо видел, чтобы Дроссель двигался в правильном направлении к чему-либо... Верно?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Say... I heard from my dad that the two of you are alchemists?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Скажи... Я слышал от отца, что вы двое алхимики?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Yes, that's right! The genius alchemist sisters, the hot topic in the town!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Да, это так! Гениальные сестры-алхимики — горячая тема в городе!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Hey, no need to get all embarrassing! We're regular, just regular alchemists!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Эй, не надо смущаться! Мы обычные, просто обычные алхимики!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Hahaha, no need to be so modest. My dad said you're pretty good!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Ха-ха-ха, не надо быть таким скромным. Мой отец сказал, что ты очень хорош!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: In which case, I've got a real important request! A life changing question!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: В таком случае у меня очень важная просьба! Вопрос, меняющий жизнь!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Life changing? Gulp! W-What do you mean?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Жизнь меняется? Глоток! Ч-что ты имеешь в виду?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Don't tell me, you want a magic potion that turns people into puppets!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Не говорите мне, что вам нужно волшебное зелье, превращающее людей в марионеток!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: I don't need anything that dangerous!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Мне не нужно ничего настолько опасного!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: What I need is a tool to hone a blade. A whetstone, polishing agent, something like that...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Мне нужен инструмент для заточки лезвия. Точильный камень, полировальное средство, что-то в этом роде...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Why? Why would a puppeteer need to maintain a blade?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: An axe, actually. I want to get a bit of a workout.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Вернее, топор. Я хочу немного потренироваться.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: An axe! You use an axe, Drossel?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: I've fought dragons, ghosts, grass monsters, all sorts of creatures, with my friends. Hundreds of battles!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Вместе со своими друзьями я сражался с драконами, призраками, травяными монстрами и разными существами. Сотни сражений!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Н-вау... Это на самом деле довольно неожиданно.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: No problem, though. We'll make just the item you need!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Но это не проблема. Мы изготовим именно то, что Вам нужно!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Hahaha! Leave it to Lydie and Sue, the beautiful and skilled alchemist sisters!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Предоставьте это Лиди и Сью, красивым и опытным сестрам-алхимикам!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: That's enough! At least just limit it to "skilled alchemists"!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Hahaha! It sounds promising. I'll be counting on you!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Звучит многообещающе. Я буду рассчитывать на тебя!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Here we go! The genius beautiful ultimate twin alchemists... uwah, I bit my tongue!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Вот так! Гениальные прекрасные алхимики-близнецы... ух, я прикусила язык!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Hahah, you deserved that. This is what you requested, here.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Ха-ха, ты это заслужил. Это то, что вы просили здесь.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Ah, thank you girls! Ah, this is going to give me some great ideas!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Ой, спасибо, девочки! О, это подарит мне несколько замечательных идей!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Huh? What do you mean? I thought you wanted to fix an axe?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Хм? Что ты имеешь в виду? Я думал, ты хочешь починить топор?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Yeah, that's right. First I'll use this to repair the axe...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Да, это так. Сначала я воспользуюсь этим, чтобы починить топор...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Then I'll get a work out fighting some monsters. Getting a bit crazy in battle...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Потом я потренируюсь сражаться с монстрами. Немного схожу с ума в бою...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Will be a great change of pace, and give me some great ideas! Well? Aren't I a genius?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Это будет отличное изменение темпа и подарит мне несколько отличных идей! Хорошо? Разве я не гений?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Genius is a stretch. Muscle brain might be better?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Гений — это преувеличение. Мышечный мозг может быть лучше?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Hahaha, give me a break, Sue!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: A change of pace can be important, anyway. This is all to create the ultimate puppet show.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: В любом случае, смена темпа может оказаться важной. Все это для создания настоящего кукольного спектакля.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Ah, you talked about that before. Just what kind of show is it going to be?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Ах, ты говорил об этом раньше. Что это будет за шоу?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Hmm, well, I don't have any concrete ideas yet... Something that appeals to the audience's emotions.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Хм, ну, конкретных идей у меня пока нет... Что-то, что апеллирует к эмоциям аудитории.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: A wonderful show, in which the puppets seem to be alive!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Замечательный спектакль, в котором куклы кажутся живыми!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: My father and I have always dreamed of putting on the ultimate puppet show! We'll move the hearts of one and all!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Мы с отцом всегда мечтали устроить настоящий кукольный спектакль! Мы тронем сердца всех и каждого!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: I'd love to see that myself, to be honest!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Я бы сам хотел это увидеть, если честно!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Me too, me too! Say, Drossel!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Я тоже, я тоже! Скажи, Дроссель!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Once that ultimate puppet show is ready, will you invite us?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Когда этот потрясающий кукольный спектакль будет готов, вы нас пригласите?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Hehe, I should work harder! For these two, and for all others who are waiting to see it!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Хе-хе, мне нужно работать усерднее! Для этих двоих и для всех остальных, кто ждет этого!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Hey, girls! I'm here to have some fun!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Эй, девочки! Я здесь, чтобы повеселиться!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Ah, welcome. Make yourself at home.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ах, добро пожаловать. Чувствуйте себя как дома.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Hahaha, thank you! The medicinal smell in the air, the bubbling cauldron!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ха-ха-ха, спасибо! Лекарственный запах в воздухе, кипящий котел!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Ah, this all takes me back. I do love the atmosphere in an atelier.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ах, это все возвращает меня назад. Мне очень нравится атмосфера в ателье.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: What's that, Drossel? You've been in other ateliers before?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Что это, Дроссель? Вы раньше бывали в других ателье?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Sure. I've got other alchemist friends. Gah! Now I'm getting excited!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Конечно. У меня есть другие друзья-алхимики. Га! Теперь я в восторге!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Hey, could I take a look around? I'll try to stay out of your way!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Эй, могу я осмотреться? Я постараюсь держаться подальше от тебя!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Sure, that should be fine... Take a look around, as much as you like!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Конечно, ничего страшного... Осматривайтесь вокруг, сколько хотите!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Yay! Thanks! I'm going to go over every inch of this place with a fine tooth comb!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ура! Спасибо! Я собираюсь пройтись по каждому дюйму этого места гребешком с мелкими зубьями!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Hey, stay away from the bedroom, will you? Nothing to see in there...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Эй, держись подальше от спальни, ладно? Ничего там смотреть...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Hehe! An atelier really is like a toy box, isn't it?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Хе-хе! Ателье действительно похоже на ящик для игрушек, не правда ли?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Is this your mom?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Это твоя мама?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Yes, that's right. She passed away...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Да, это так. Она скончалась...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Ah, sorry for asking... It's tough not being able to see your mom, isn't it?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ах, извини, что спрашиваю... Тяжело не видеться с мамой, не так ли?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Well... What's your mom like, Drossel?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ну... Какая твоя мама, Дроссель?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: She's kind. So very kind, and bright like the sun.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Она добрая. Такой добрый и яркий, как солнышко.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Hehe. Just like you then, Drossel!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Хе-хе. Совсем как ты, Дроссель!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: No, not as insensitive as me. She's prettier, and brighter. I want to be just like her.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Нет, не такой бесчувственный, как я. Она красивее и ярче. Я хочу быть такой же, как она.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: I can barely remember her face, to be honest, but I still want to meet her and see her again.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Честно говоря, я едва помню ее лицо, но мне все равно хочется встретиться с ней и увидеть ее снова.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Oh, Drossel...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ох, Дроссель...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Ah, sorry! I didn't mean to do this in front of you two.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ах, извини! Я не хотел делать это в присутствии вас двоих.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Don't worry. We were happy to hear about it, Drossel.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Не волнуйся. Мы были рады услышать об этом, Дроссель.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: I'm sure you'll meet your mom again one day. Don't give up!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Я уверен, что однажды ты снова встретишь свою маму. Не сдавайтесь!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Thanks. You two really are something special. It was fun looking around your atelier. See you!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Спасибо. Вы двое действительно особенные. Было интересно осмотреть ваше ателье. Увидимся!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Drossel is sad about not being able to see her mom, isn't she...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Дроссель грустит из-за того, что не может увидеть свою маму, не так ли...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Of course she is. I wonder if there's anything we could do to reunite them?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Конечно, она есть. Интересно, можем ли мы что-нибудь сделать, чтобы воссоединить их?
